questions: Does CI build gguf/onnx/ffi/python? What breaks when each is compiled?
What is the FFI/Python inference reroute surface (entry points, deadlocks)?

findings.summary: rust.yml builds default features only (2 jobs, 3-OS); no gguf/onnx/ffi/python leg. codeql.yml is the only other workflow

Per-feature clippy -D warnings debt (measured by compiling): ffi=18 (17 missing_safety_doc across auth/health/inference/models/streaming + 1 not_unsafe_ptr_arg_deref runtime.rs:31) + ffi/inference.rs 272>250 Razor; onnx=2 (embedder.rs:53,101); python=3 (field-assign-Default + 2 redundant closures, builds clean); gguf=6 (pos-loop-counter x3, f32 cast, clamp, return)
ffi/error.rs exhaustiveness already fixed; --features ffi COMPILES; only clippy fails. --features python cargo check exit 0

5 deadlocking inference entry points (no worker in FFI/Python init): core_infer, core_infer_bounded (adds output buffer), core_infer_streaming (fake-stream single callback), Session::infer, AsyncSession::infer. Reroute -> Runtime::infer/infer_stream (gguf-gated streaming)
B-25 splits: (1) CI-foundation cycle [next]: clippy-clean 4 features + Razor-extract ffi/inference.rs + 4 CI legs (L2, mechanical); (2) FFI/Python reroute [deferred, L3]
